author: John Actis
text: They are doing a job next door, pushed 4 wheel barrow of dirt throught the fence. Said it wasn't there problem to fix,  even though their workers did it. Garage!

author: Ken Hardin
text: After my home warranty sent out Big Boy plumbing (who not only had trouble diagnosing the problem, leaving my family to struggle with our water heater for 3 weeks and later wanted to charge me an additional $250 after I paid the $90 warranty fee when the warranty refused to cover it) Mike from Drain Pro came out, charged only $150 after quickly diagnosing the problem, AND unclogged and reset our garbage disposal without charging us, also leaving us a tool to reset it ourselves. Drain Pro was highly recommended by a friend and now I know exactly why.

author: Katrina Brown
text: I’ve used Drain Pro several times now. They’ve fixed a couple of leaky pipes and recently cleared a clog in my kitchen sink. Mike is very responsive, and Robert did a great job with my sink. Quick, clean and efficient. Worth every penny!

author: Mountain Management
text: Highly recommend Drain Pro, I've called them several times for clogged sewer lines and a major leak at our rental and Mike is quick to respond and dispatch a plumber out to fix issues. Since finding Drain Pro, they've become our go to plumbing service. Pricing is also affordable. Thank you Drain Pro!

author: Cassidy Sheppard
text: Plumbing issue was addressed at the property I rent, but the tech left behind a mess. When the tech called me after I complained he told me “we’re not really a cleaning service and I did my best”. He then asked “are you gonna take care of it yourself or do you want me to schedule another time to come back and clean.” The pictures show his best.
